requirements.title: Pointer association permits target reference and exact target mutation through the pointer
requirements.definition: Pointer association between a pointer and a target allows the target to be referenced by a reference to the pointer.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.

S19.5.2.1-001 pointer-association runtime fixtures: one run/effect/f2023 program pointer-assigns one pointer to target read_target=42 and reads through the pointer into a distinguished sentinel, then pointer-assigns another pointer to write_target=1, assigns through the pointer, and reads write_target=77 directly. Feature mutants redirect each pointer assignment to a different target so the read and write assertions fail.

requirements.title: Pointers can be associated, disassociated, undefined, or associated with different own-image targets over time
requirements.definition: During execution a pointer may be undefined, associated with different targets on its own image, or disassociated.

requirements.title: Associated data pointers share definition status, deferred parameters or shape, and polymorphic dynamic type with their target
requirements.definition: The definition status of an associated data pointer is that of its target. Deferred type parameters or shape are assumed from the target, and a polymorphic pointer assumes the dynamic type of the target.

Source registration only. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.

S19.5.2.1-003 pointer-association runtime fixtures: one program associates defined scalar, rank-one, deferred-length character, and polymorphic pointers with defined targets. It reads the scalar value, inquires LBOUND/UBOUND and element value directly through the pointer, checks LEN and padded character equality, and SELECT TYPEs a child dynamic type. Feature mutants redirect each pointer assignment to a different conforming target.
